---
name: start-backlog-task
description: Claim and execute one ready product or tooling task
---

Read the owning board, task dependencies, architecture, testing strategy, and
prompt index. Select one ready task, inspect the worktree, mark it in progress,
and keep changes within its acceptance contract. Use the product board for
`TASK-*` work and the tooling roadmap for `BT-T*` work.

Implement code, tests, contracts, documentation, and validation together.
Finish by updating the task status and reporting focused, local, native, and
higher-level results separately, including exact blockers.
